episodes.title: Red Roses
episodes.summary: What starts as a YouTube video going viral, soon leads to problems for the teenagers of Lakewood and serves as the catalyst for a murder that opens up a window to the town's troubled past.

episodes.title: Hello, Emma
episodes.summary: Another teen's death raises questions; the rift between Emma and Audrey grows; a podcaster reports on the town's murders.

episodes.title: Wanna Play a Game?
episodes.summary: Emma learns that her mother has been keeping even more secrets; the Killer challenges Emma to a dangerous game.

episodes.title: Aftermath
episodes.summary: A mysterious message sends Emma and Audrey in search of answers.

episodes.title: Exposed
episodes.summary: Emma learns a heartbreaking secret after a scandalous video leak.

episodes.title: Betrayed
episodes.summary: The new prime suspect is someone close to Emma.

episodes.title: In the Trenches
episodes.summary: Emma races to save a friend from the killer's dangerous game of hide-and-seek.

episodes.title: Ghosts
episodes.summary: Emma is shaken by another death; and uncovers a secret from the past.

episodes.title: The Dance
episodes.summary: Emma, who doubts that the actual killer has been captured, teams with Piper to find answers at the Halloween dance.

episodes.title: Revelations
episodes.summary: In the Season 1 finale, Emma tries to save a loved one and also learns the identity of the killer.

episodes.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
episodes.summary: Emma returns to Lakewood looking to move past last season's killings. However, a dream begins to haunt Emma and a mysterious provocateur threatens to expose Audrey's connection to Piper and the safety of our Lakewood Six.

episodes.title: Psycho
episodes.summary: Tensions rise when Maggie reveals information relating to Emma's past. Emma attempts to take control of her fears as a someone unexpected arrives in town. Noah investigates an unsettling new lead for his podcast.

episodes.title: Vacancy
episodes.summary: Emma grapples with the implications of her father's return, while a bloody gift reveals Audrey's stalker has graduated from fun and games to outright murder. Branson returns to Lakewood leaving Brooke to question his intentions.

episodes.title: Happy Birthday to Me
episodes.summary: Jake's sudden disappearance is beginning to worry Brooke until a gift from Jake arrives just in time for Kieran's birthday party. The Lakewood Six take an unexpected trip deep into their subconscious.

episodes.title: Dawn of the Dead
episodes.summary: The death of a loved one hits hard and GW High goes into lockdown. Suspicions rise among the Lakewood 5 who wonder if it's all happening again and if one of their own is the Killer…

episodes.title: Jeepers Creepers
episodes.summary: Emma starts to question her friendships when tensions rise between her and her friends. Meanwhile, Noah reveals his latest theory about the identity of Piper's accomplice. Noah takes his investigation further.

episodes.title: Let the Right One In
episodes.summary: Eli takes Emma on a criminal adventure while Noah's relationship with Zoe escalates and the Killer lures Brooke and Audrey into a deadly trap.

episodes.title: Village of the Damned
episodes.summary: The Lakewood Days Carnival descends into madness when the Killer forces Emma through a gauntlet of not so fun and games, while Brooke launches an attack on the entire town…

episodes.title: The Orphanage
episodes.summary: Emma and Audrey discover why the Killer is targeting them, Noah loses something dear to him, and a long missing body of evidence is finally located.

episodes.title: The Vanishing
episodes.summary: As Audrey and Emma are driven further apart by the Killer, Maggie and Acosta worry that the secrets of their past might be threatening the present, and Noah's affection for Zoe is used against him.

episodes.title: Heavenly Creatures
episodes.summary: In the wake of another murder, Emma and Audrey find themselves primes suspect when evidence appears implicating them both in the killing spree.

episodes.title: When a Stranger Calls
episodes.summary: In the shocking season 2 finale, Emma and Audrey must make a daring move. Finally facing off with the Killer, they unmask Piper's final surprise.

episodes.title: The Deadfast Club
episodes.summary: GhostFace is back! When a shadowy figure from Deion's past returns to haunt his present, it threatens the lives of him and his newfound friends.

episodes.title: Devil's Night
episodes.summary: The group decides to turn the tables and set a trap for their would-be killer.

episodes.title: The Man Behind the Mask
episodes.summary: On Halloween night, GhostFace lures the Deadfast Club out of the city to the suburbs. Tricks rather than treats ensue, leaving the group bloodied and battered.

episodes.title: Ports in the Storm
episodes.summary: When put to another test, each member of the group must choose who they trust the most.

episodes.title: Blindspots
episodes.summary: As suspicions sharpen and loyalties fray, the Deadfast Club desperately searches for the man behind GhostFace's mask... only to be disturbed by what they find.

episodes.title: Endgame
episodes.summary: GhostFace's deadly game draws to an end!
